:::{#cor-conditioning-reduces-entropy}
#### Conditioning reduces entropy

For [discrete random variables](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/random-variables.html#def-discrete-rv) $X$ and $Y$
with finite entropies, <!-- check-term-links: allow -->

$$\entropyf{Y \mid X} \le \entropyf{Y}.$$

Equality holds exactly when $X$ and $Y$ are
[independent](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/independence.html#def-indpt).

:::

::: {.proof}

By @thm-mutual-information-reduction,

$$\entropyf{Y} - \entropyf{Y \mid X} = \mutinfof{X}{Y}.$$

By @thm-mutual-information-nonnegative,
the right side is nonnegative,
and it is $0$ exactly when $X$ and $Y$ are [independent](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/independence.html#def-indpt).

:::
